We propose to pretrain the encoder and the de- coder of a sequence-to-sequence model under both mono- lingual and cross-lingual settings. The pre-training objective encourages the model to represent different languages in the shared space, so that we can conduct zero-shot cross-lingual transfer. After the pre-training procedure, we use monolin- gual data to ﬁne-tune the pre-trained model on downstream NLG tasks.
